##### Project general facts

Nesba 2 Aljada by Arada is a contemporary residential building within a large mixed-use master community, featuring fluid architecture and generous balconies that frame the surrounding urban landscape. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors and offers one-bedroom apartments through to spacious three-bedroom family homes, each equipped with integrated smart home technology and a layout that emphasises a seamless indoor-outdoor connection.

Residents step directly onto an outdoor sports complex with a full-size football field, five-a-side pitches and courts for badminton, basketball, volleyball and padel. A boulevard of shops and restaurants, a food-truck enclave, a drive-in cinema, a large skate park, a fitness centre, a trampoline arena, adventure playgrounds and interactive water play zones add variety, alongside a swimming pool and a gym for everyday wellness.

Kitchens are fitted with a cooker, an extractor hood and a washer-dryer from a premium manufacturer, while modern finishes in high-quality materials convey refined simplicity throughout the home. Balconies extend the living space outdoors and bring in natural light. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Muwaileh is a fast-growing residential district of Sharjah, set beside University City and close to the Aljada master community. Modern apartment buildings, schools, clinics, supermarkets and neighbourhood retail make it a practical, family-friendly area, while universities and research institutions nearby give it a lively, youthful atmosphere throughout the academic year.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Emirates Road and University City Road connect residents with Sharjah city centre, Dubai and the northern emirates. University City and Sahara Centre are a short drive away, Sharjah International Airport and the Al Majaz Waterfront are close by, and Dubai International Airport, Deira and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance.

Sharjah allows property ownership for international buyers in designated communities and offers some of the most accessible prices in the UAE. Large master-planned communities with walkable streets, retail and leisure facilities attract families, students and young professionals, supporting steady rental demand. Competitive prices and strong road links to Dubai underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
